arguments.name: logits
arguments.semantic_role: rank-local input logits before FP32 cast

arguments.name: row_max
arguments.semantic_role: local maximum, later overwritten by global MAX all-reduce

arguments.name: logits
arguments.semantic_role: same rank-local FP16 logits; must be shifted using global_max

arguments.name: global_max
arguments.semantic_role: completed MAX all-reduce result, not local max

arguments.name: predicted_local
arguments.semantic_role: shifted target logit if owned, else zero; SUM all-reduced next

arguments.name: denominator_local
arguments.semantic_role: sum exp(logit-global_max) over local vocab; SUM all-reduced next

arguments.name: exp_values
arguments.semantic_role: exp(logit-global_max), later divided in-place by global denominator and saved as softmax

arguments.name: target_local
arguments.semantic_role: target-vocab_start if owned, zero or sentinel if masked; consumed by backward

arguments.name: rank
arguments.semantic_role: TP rank used to derive vocab start/end
